Container.Name: lemonfiber
Container.Overview: Sets up and runs a media stack. This container holds the host's Docker socket, which is control of the host's Docker: whoever holds it can start a privileged container that mounts the host's root. It shares the host's network, so the stack's services are reached on the host's loopback, and the web surface listens on the host's loopback until a password is set. The terminal interface: docker exec -it lemonfiber lemonfiber

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: The host's Docker socket. It is control of the host's Docker: whoever holds it can start a privileged container that mounts the host's root. lemonfiber runs as group 281, Unraid's docker group, set in Extra Parameters; change --group-add there if yours differs.

Config.Name: lemonfiber's directory
Config.Description: Its settings and the stack it writes. The container path must be the same as the host path, and the same as the start of XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME below: Compose resolves the stack's mounts on the host, and lemonfiber refuses to start a stack whose paths differ.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Where your library and downloads live. The container path must be the same as the host path. Choose it as the data location during setup.

Config.Name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
Config.Description: Where lemonfiber keeps its settings, under its directory.

Config.Name: XDG_DATA_HOME
Config.Description: Where lemonfiber writes the stack, under its directory.
